The Chinese characters for Eric

As a transliteration, Eric is usually written 埃里克 (Āi lǐ kè). Each character is listed below with its own dictionary meaning — the name is chosen by sound, not by meaning, and Moying does not translate names. Please have a person review the characters before any permanent use such as a tattoo.

Origin and meaning

The name Eric has Norse roots and means “eternal ruler”.

About the name Eric

A Norse name meaning 'eternal ruler', common across Scandinavia.

As a gift or a tattoo

If you are choosing a name for a print or a tattoo, Eric carries the meaning “eternal ruler” and looks striking in brush strokes.
